exam.title: AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional
exam.study_prerequisites: No formal certification prerequisite; AWS targets candidates with two or more years building production applications on AWS or open-source technologies, general AI/ML or data-engineering experience, and one year implementing generative-AI solutions. Practice governed multimodal data, RAG and evaluation, model abstraction, prompts, agents/tools/state, enterprise integration, safety/security, deployment, observability, performance/cost optimization and evidence-driven troubleshooting.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Foundation Model Integration, Data Management, and Compliance
Operational Efficiency and Optimization for GenAI Applications

review.notes: The current standard five-domain AIP-C01 guide was reconciled with every detailed domain page, the live 180-minute/75-question/USD-300 certification page, non-exhaustive service list and March 2026 post-beta scope refresh. Three scenarios, eight safe labs and 42 original checks cover governed multimodal data and retrieval, model/prompt lifecycle, agents/tools/state and enterprise integration, layered safety/security/governance, operational optimization, multi-perspective evaluation and evidence-driven troubleshooting. All 17 unique URLs are cataloged; automated link totals are updated from the source-health run. Fast-changing model/service/training metadata is labeled, the AgentCore-era standard exam is separated from early beta outlines/unofficial codes, and no recalled questions are used.

findings.title: Agent control boundaries too abstract
findings.evidence: Policy supports tool/input and session-aware rules at Gateway; credentials and content filters serve other functions.
findings.recommendation: Add component/control map and per-call versus cumulative budget case.
findings.resolution: Add component/control map and per-call versus cumulative budget case.

findings.title: Ingestion lifecycle lacks concrete behavior
findings.evidence: Connector sync incrementally handles source changes; metadata optimizations have exceptions.

findings.title: Named implementation objective missing
findings.evidence: BDA structures multimodal input for application workflows.
findings.recommendation: Add task 1.3/2.5.3 bridge and extraction-validation boundary.
findings.resolution: Add task 1.3/2.5.3 bridge and extraction-validation boundary.

findings.title: Region choice needs explicit residency boundary
findings.evidence: Geographic and global profiles route to different possible destinations.
findings.recommendation: Add Region permission/data-processing distinction and CloudTrail evidence.
findings.resolution: Add Region permission/data-processing distinction and CloudTrail evidence.

findings.title: CI evaluation example cannot prove user-role enforcement
findings.evidence: M2M example bypasses role checks; stored traces describe a prior run.
findings.recommendation: Adopt evaluation-gate concept with separate authorization and current-code tests.
findings.resolution: Adopt evaluation-gate concept with separate authorization and current-code tests.

findings.title: Conflicting App Runner historical closure dates
findings.evidence: Product page April 30, 2026 versus API March 31, 2026.
findings.recommendation: Keep the support limitation visible pending authoritative evidence.

blog_intake.read_scope: Architecture, evaluation modes, OAuth approaches and three-layer auth description; code not executed.
blog_intake.value: Connect CI quality gates to representative authenticated behavior.
blog_intake.limits: Stored traces do not validate PR code; role-bypassing M2M path does not validate user authorization; judge scores may vary.

labs.offline_checks: Sixteen synthetic arithmetic and policy assertions across five worked decisions.
